8.2.1 ComM_InitStatusType
[SWS_ComM_00668] Definition of datatype ComM_InitStatusType ⌈
Name
ComM_InitStatusType
Kind
Enumeration
COMM_UNINIT
0x00
The COM Manager is not initialized or not
usable. This shall be the default value after
reset. This status shall have the value 0.
Range
COMM_INIT
0x01
The COM Manager is initialized and usable.
Description
Initialization status of ComM.
Available via
ComM.h
⌋()
